wiki.title: Dennis Guth
wiki.extract: Dennis Guth (born 1955) is an American politician, currently the Iowa State Senator from the 28th District. A Republican, he has served in the Iowa Senate since winning an election against Bob Jennings in 2012, flipping the seat from Democratic to Republican.
